description: This file defines the RateLimiter class within the Aws\Retry namespace, implementing rate limiting logic for request throttling and token management as part of the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes methods for updating the sending rate, acquiring tokens, and internal calculations related to rate control, with configurable options.

classes.name: RateLimiter
classes.description: A class that manages request rate limiting using token bucket and cubic throttle algorithms, configurable through constructor options, to control the rate of AWS SDK requests.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RateLimiter with optional configuration parameters such as beta, min_capacity, min_fill_rate, scale_constant, smooth, and an optional time_provider.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the rate limiter is enabled.

methods.name: getSendToken
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a token for sending a request; calls acquireToken(1).

methods.name: updateSendingRate
methods.description: Updates the sending rate based on whether the request was throttled, adjusting internal parameters using cubic throttle and success functions.

methods.name: acquireToken
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a token of a specified amount, refilling tokens as needed, and sleeping to throttle if necessary.

methods.name: calculateTimeWindow
methods.description: Calculates the current time window used for rate adjustment based on last maximum rate and beta.

methods.name: cubicSuccess
methods.description: Calculates the success rate after a successful request, based on the time since last throttle.

methods.name: cubicThrottle
methods.description: Calculates a throttled rate based on a fraction of the current rate.

methods.name: enableTokenBucket
methods.description: Enables the token bucket, setting the enabled flag to true.

methods.name: refillTokenBucket
methods.description: Refills the token bucket based on elapsed time and current fill rate.

methods.name: time
methods.description: Returns the current time from the provided time provider callable or microtime.

methods.name: updateMeasuredRate
methods.description: Updates the measured transaction rate based on recent request timestamps.

methods.name: updateTokenBucketRate
methods.description: Updates the fill rate and maximum capacity of the token bucket based on a new rate.
